meta.project: Dashboard Takmir Masjid Al-Falah Berbasis Web

product_overview: Aplikasi web terpusat untuk mengelola operasional Masjid Al-Falah, mencakup dashboard transparansi, program kerja, keuangan, jemaah, inventaris, dan komunikasi takmir. Sistem ini mendukung RBAC untuk Ketua, Sekretaris, dan Bendahara agar administrasi lebih efisien, aman, dan mudah dianalisis.
core_goals: Menyentralisasi data dan aktivitas operasional masjid dalam satu sistem web
Meningkatkan transparansi keuangan, program kerja, dan aktivitas jemaah
Mendukung kolaborasi berbasis peran untuk Ketua, Sekretaris, dan Bendahara
Menyediakan analitik ringkasan, tren, dan status operasional untuk pengambilan keputusan
Mempermudah input, pembaruan, dan pelacakan data melalui API yang aman dan responsif

features.name: Authentication & Session Management
features.description: Pengguna dapat mendaftar, masuk, dan memeriksa status sesi untuk mengakses modul sesuai peran.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/sign-up/email with valid email, password, and name -> Receive 200 with created account data -> POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT/session token -> GET /api/auth/get-session -> Receive 200 with active session details
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with invalid password -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
POST /api/auth/sign-up/email with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Health & System Status
features.description: Sistem menyediakan endpoint kesehatan untuk memantau status API dan middleware keamanan.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with healthy status and security middleware checks
GET /api/health during normal operation -> Receive 200 with system status
GET /api/health when service is unavailable -> Receive non-200 error response

features.name: Dashboard & Transparency Analytics
features.description: Menampilkan ringkasan operasional dan finansial, data arus kas, program mendatang, serta aktivitas dashboard untuk pengguna publik dan takmir.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard/summary -> Receive 200 with summary cards for cash balance, jemaah total, asset count, and nearest program

GET /api/dashboard/cashflow -> Receive 200 with monthly cashflow chart data -> GET /api/dashboard/upcoming-programs -> Receive 200 with upcoming program list -> GET /api/dashboard/completed-programs -> Receive 200 with completed program list
GET /api/dashboard/allocation without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
GET /api/dashboard/recent-activity with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with recent activity feed
GET /api/dashboard/allocation with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with budget allocation breakdown

features.name: Financial Transactions & Donations
features.description: Mengelola ringkasan keuangan, transaksi kas internal, dan donasi publik Infaq/Shodaqoh.
user_flows: GET /api/transactions/summary -> Receive 200 with total income, expense, and balance
POST /api/transactions/public-donate with valid donorName, amount, and type -> Receive 201 with donation record confirmation
GET /api/transactions with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with transaction list -> GET /api/transactions/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with transaction details
POST /api/transactions with valid auth token and valid title, amount, type, category, and date -> Receive 201 with created transaction
PUT /api/transactions/:id with valid auth token and update payload -> Receive 200 with updated transaction
DELETE /api/transactions/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/transactions/public-donate with invalid amount or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/transactions/:id with valid auth token for missing record -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Programs & Work Plan Management
features.description: Mengelola data program kerja masjid, status kanban, kalender publik, dan penyelesaian program dengan laporan.
user_flows: GET /api/programs/summary -> Receive 200 with program counts and KPI overview -> GET /api/programs/feed.ics -> Receive 200 with public iCal feed
GET /api/programs with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with program list -> POST /api/programs with valid auth token and title, category, targetDate, budget -> Receive 201 with created program

GET /api/programs/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with program details -> PATCH /api/programs/:id/status with valid status payload -> Receive 200 with updated kanban status -> PATCH /api/programs/:id/complete with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with completion confirmation
POST /api/programs with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/programs/:id with valid auth token for missing program -> Receive 404 not found response
DELETE /api/programs/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation

features.name: Jemaah (Congregation) Management
features.description: Menyimpan, menampilkan, dan memperbarui data jemaah, termasuk registrasi publik dan ringkasan demografi.
user_flows: GET /api/jemaah/summary -> Receive 200 with aggregate demographic counts -> GET /api/jemaah with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with jemaah records list
POST /api/jemaah/public-register with valid nama, noHp, alamat, and kategori -> Receive 201 with registration confirmation
GET /api/jemaah/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with jemaah details -> PUT /api/jemaah/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with updated jemaah record
POST /api/jemaah with valid auth token and complete data -> Receive 201 with created jemaah record
DELETE /api/jemaah/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/jemaah/public-register with missing fields or invalid kategori -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/jemaah/:id with valid auth token for missing record -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Inventaris (Assets) Management
features.description: Mencatat dan memantau aset masjid beserta kondisi, lokasi, dan ringkasan inventaris.
user_flows: GET /api/inventaris/summary -> Receive 200 with aggregate inventory summary -> GET /api/inventaris with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with asset list
POST /api/inventaris with valid auth token and namaBarang, jumlah, kondisi, lokasi -> Receive 201 with created asset record
GET /api/inventaris/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with asset details -> PUT /api/inventaris/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with updated asset record
DELETE /api/inventaris/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/inventaris with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Articles & News
features.description: Menerbitkan dan mengelola artikel atau berita masjid untuk halaman publik.
user_flows: GET /api/articles -> Receive 200 with published article list -> GET /api/articles/:id -> Receive 200 with article details
POST /api/articles with valid auth token and title, content, category -> Receive 201 with created article
PUT /api/articles/:id with valid auth token and update payload -> Receive 200 with updated article
DELETE /api/articles/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
GET /api/articles/:id for missing article -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Contact Messages
features.description: Menangani pesan masuk dari pengunjung dan tindak lanjut balasan takmir.
user_flows: POST /api/contact-messages with valid name, email, and message -> Receive 201 with submission confirmation
GET /api/contact-messages with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with message list -> PATCH /api/contact-messages/:id/status with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with updated status
DELETE /api/contact-messages/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/contact-messages with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Ziswaf Management
features.description: Mencatat dan menampilkan transaksi Ziswaf yang dikelola takmir.
user_flows: GET /api/ziswaf with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with ziswaf transaction records
POST /api/ziswaf with valid auth token and muzakkiName, amount, type -> Receive 201 with created ziswaf record
POST /api/ziswaf with invalid amount or missing fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Schedules Management
features.description: Mengelola jadwal shalat, khutbah, dan agenda kegiatan masjid.
user_flows: GET /api/jadwal -> Receive 200 with prayer and activity schedule list
POST /api/jadwal with valid auth token and schedule data -> Receive 201 with created schedule entry
POST /api/jadwal with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Settings
features.description: Mengelola konfigurasi aplikasi dan parameter masjid.
user_flows: GET /api/settings -> Receive 200 with application settings -> GET /api/settings/:key -> Receive 200 with a single setting value
PUT /api/settings/:key with valid auth token and value payload -> Receive 200 with updated configuration
PUT /api/settings/:key without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
GET /api/settings/:key for unknown key -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Menampilkan notifikasi pengguna dan menandai seluruh notifikasi sebagai telah dibaca.
user_flows: GET /api/notifications with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with notification list -> PATCH /api/notifications/mark-all-read with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with read-confirmation
GET /api/notifications without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: User Management
features.description: Mengelola akun takmir dan peran pengguna untuk mendukung RBAC di seluruh modul.
user_flows: GET /api/users with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with takmir user list -> POST /api/users with valid auth token and email, name, role -> Receive 201 with invited or created user
PATCH /api/users/:id/role with valid auth token and role payload -> Receive 200 with updated role
DELETE /api/users/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with deleted user confirmation
POST /api/users with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
